label: PAYG instalments automatic entry, individual or trust: notional tax
quote: tax payable on your latest notice of assessment of $1,000 or more estimated (notional) tax of $500 or more
pattern: notice of assessment of \$[\d,]+ or more estimated \(notional\) tax of (\$[\d,]+) or more
notes: Individuals and trusts enter when all three entry thresholds are met. The page states no start date. These are the ATO's thresholds: Division 45 in Schedule 1 to the Taxation Administration Act 1953 lets the Commissioner give an instalment rate (s 45-15), and no entry threshold was found in it (compilation of 1 April 2026), so the period stays the retrieval date.
